title: give the reviewer a ready overlay command that runs the new test against the base version of a changed file, so the mutation check can run read-only without retyping the whole file

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
The reviewer reported this as tool feedback (friction) on ork in ork run ork-20261125-131821-14b9, project ork, item S544:

give the reviewer a ready overlay command that runs the new test against the base version of a changed file, so the mutation check can run read-only without retyping the whole file

Evidence: to confirm the red run I had to trace HEAD:internal/cache/cache.go by hand because the overlay would need a ~700-line copy written to the temp dir
